title: Goecia: Forgotten Rites
description: Goecia is a dark fantasy expansion mod focused on exploration atmosphere and progression. The mod introduces dangerous new environments creatures structures and equipment designed to make you feel immersed.
body:
# About Goecia

Goecia is a dark fantasy Minecraft mod focused on atmosphere, exploration, progression, and dangerous supernatural creatures while maintaining a vanilla-inspired style.

The mod introduces cursed environments, hostile demonic creatures, ancient structures, new equipment, decorative blocks, and progression systems designed for players looking for a more challenging and immersive survival experience.

Goecia focuses heavily on environmental storytelling and visual identity, creating a world inspired by dark fantasy, ancient civilizations, and supernatural themes while still feeling naturally integrated into Minecraft.

### Features
- Custom dark fantasy biome
- New ores and materials
- New weapons and armor sets
- Decorative dark fantasy blocks
- Ancient structures with loot
- Hostile demonic creatures
- Corruption mechanic
- Core of Life progression system
- Trade system with special wandering characters
- Purple fire decorative elements
- Vanilla-style progression and exploration

### DemonWood Forest
Goecia currently adds the Demonwood Forest, a custom biome focused on atmosphere and exploration. The biome features unique trees, vegetation, ruins, and dark fantasy environments designed to blend naturally into Minecraft’s world generation while creating a darker and more dangerous atmosphere.

### Core of Life
The Core of Life is one of the main progression systems in Goecia.
Players can permanently increase their maximum health by consuming rare Core of Life items found throughout the world. As vitality increases, the health bar evolves visually through different stages:
- Orange vitality
- Blue vitality
- Purple vitality

Players can eventually reach up to three full health bars, for a maximum of 60 health points.

### Corruption System
Goecia introduces a corruption mechanic tied to demonic influence and cursed environments.
As corruption increases, players become more vulnerable and enemies deal increasingly higher damage. Exploring dangerous areas without preparation can quickly become deadly.
Players can reduce corruption by trading with special wandering characters hidden throughout the world.

### Structures and Exploration
The world of Goecia contains multiple structures designed to reward exploration:
- Ritual ruins
- Decorative structures
- Exorcist Towers
- Nether portal structures
- Thematic forest ruins

Many of these locations contain loot, hostile creatures, rare materials, and progression-related rewards.

### Hostile Creatures
Goecia adds multiple hostile supernatural creatures inspired by dark fantasy themes, including:
- Imps
- Servants
- Insect Demons
- Exorcists

Some creatures have dimensional variants depending on where they spawn, while others guard structures and dangerous regions.

### Equipment and Progression
Players can craft multiple weapons, tools, and armor sets using the ores and materials added by the mod, including demonic resources obtained from hostile creatures.
Goecia also adds special consumable apples crafted with materials from the mod, granting different vanilla potion effects useful during survival and combat.
